Placeholder is probably "a pincer beetle". Not entirely certain of his respawn time. Killed him then sat on his supposed respawn location. 2.5 hours later no respawn of either a pincer beetle or him neither at that location or generally near by. Logged off, came back 30 minutes later and he was up. Could be some variance involved. I have also seen him NW of the gypsy camp, so he roams further than once thought. In five kills he had the Spectacles each time.  

Midraim is quite rare, and makes an appearance once every few days.
